data.contents: By using the EnviroCar platform, you agree to share your vehicle telemetry data for research and public service purposes, while retaining the right to request deletion of your personal data at any time. The data may be used in aggregated form for environmental analysis, traffic studies, and open data initiatives. You may withdraw consent by contacting support@example.com. The terms may be updated periodically; continued use constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
